calculadora.passaDoExato: The result goes past what can be computed exactly.
calculadora.pedidoInteiros: Two or more whole numbers, separated by commas.

circuloTrig.descricao: Unit circle with an angle of {graus} degrees in quadrant {quadrante}. Cosine {cosseno}, sine {seno}.
corpoObs.barra pela ponta: The same rod turning about its end resists four times as much.
corpoObs.barra pelo centro: Here r is the full length, not the distance to the axis.
corpoObs.casca cilíndrica: A hoop, or a thin-walled tube: everything at the rim.
corpoObs.casca esférica: Same radius, all the mass on the surface — a larger factor than the solid sphere.
corpoObs.disco ou cilindro maciço: Half the mass sits near the axis, so the factor drops.
corpoObs.esfera maciça: The mass gathers even closer to the centre.
corpoObs.partícula: All the mass at distance r from the axis — the reference case.
curriculo.area.algebra.descricao: Swapping numbers for letters to solve the general case at once.
curriculo.area.calculo-1.descricao: Derivatives: the mathematics of what changes, instant by instant.
curriculo.area.calculo-2.descricao: Integrals: adding infinitely many infinitely small parts.
curriculo.area.calculo-3.descricao: Multivariable calculus: differentiating and integrating in more than one direction.
curriculo.area.calculo-4.descricao: Differential equations: the rule by which quantities change.
curriculo.area.estatistica.descricao: Counting possibilities and measuring uncertainty — no real measurement is exact. It is not an engineering prerequisite, which is why it closes the path.
curriculo.area.fisica.descricao: Mathematics applied to the world: from the inclined plane to the rocket in orbit.
curriculo.area.funcoes.descricao: The language engineering uses to describe one quantity depending on another.
curriculo.area.geometria-analitica.descr: Geometry solved with algebra, once the plane has coordinates.
curriculo.area.geometria.descricao: Measuring space: angles, areas and volumes before moving to coordinates.
curriculo.area.matematica-basica.descric: The foundation: how numbers combine, compare and measure.
curriculo.area.pre-calculo.descricao: The bridge: the idea of approximation, before the machinery of calculus — from intuitive to formal.
curriculo.area.trigonometria.descricao: Angles become numbers — and that is how a trajectory is computed.
curriculo.area.vetores-matrizes.descrica: Quantities with direction and tables of numbers: the toolkit of mechanics.
curriculo.topico.analise-combinatoria.de: The multiplication principle, arrangements, permutations and combinations.
curriculo.topico.analise-dimensional.des: The dimensions of quantities and how to check a formula without computing anything.
curriculo.topico.angulos-e-triangulos.de: Angle sum, congruence and the triangle inequality.
Maxima and minima, concavity, optimization and related rates.
Area between curves, volume of solids of revolution and arc length.
curriculo.topico.aplicacoes-de-edo.descr: Setting up the equation: cooling, decay, RL circuit and mixing.
curriculo.topico.areas-de-figuras-planas: Where each area formula comes from, and why the ratio of areas is k².
curriculo.topico.cinematica-escalar.desc: Uniform and uniformly accelerated motion, motion graphs and the area under the velocity curve.
curriculo.topico.cinematica-vetorial.des: Position, velocity and acceleration as vectors, in two and three dimensions.
curriculo.topico.circulo-e-poligonos.des: Circumference, area of the circle, sectors and regular polygons.
From the triangle to the circle of radius 1, radians and angles beyond 90°.
curriculo.topico.circunferencia.descrica: Standard and general equations, and how a line can meet a circle.
curriculo.topico.composicao-inversa.desc: Chaining functions and reflecting the graph in the line y = x.
curriculo.topico.conceito-funcao.descric: Domain, codomain, range and the vertical line test.
curriculo.topico.conicas.descricao: Ellipse, parabola and hyperbola as sections of a cone — and as orbits.
curriculo.topico.continuidade.descricao: Functions without jumps and the intermediate value theorem.
curriculo.topico.coordenadas-no-espaco.d: Changing systems so the symmetry drops out of the computation — and the Jacobian.
curriculo.topico.definicao-de-derivada.d: From secant to tangent: the limit of Newton’s quotient.
curriculo.topico.derivacao-implicita.des: Differentiating without solving for y, which is the way when the curve is not a function.
curriculo.topico.derivadas-exponencial-l: The function that is its own derivative, and the one that becomes 1/x.
curriculo.topico.derivadas-parciais.desc: Differentiating one direction at a time, and what second order reveals.
curriculo.topico.derivadas-trigonometric: Differentiating sine, cosine and tangent — and why the derivative of sine is cosine.
curriculo.topico.dinamica-rotacional.des: Moment of inertia, torque and the second law for rotation.
curriculo.topico.distribuicao-normal.des: The bell curve: mean, standard deviation and the 68-95-99 rule.
curriculo.topico.edo-primeira-ordem.desc: Separating variables, integrating factor, transient and steady state.
curriculo.topico.edo-segunda-ordem.descr: The characteristic equation and the three damping regimes.
curriculo.topico.equacao-primeiro-grau.d: Solving ax + b = 0 and seeing the root as where the line crosses the x-axis.
curriculo.topico.equacao-segundo-grau.de: The quadratic formula, the discriminant and the three possible root situations.
curriculo.topico.equacoes-parametricas.d: The curve described by time: x(t) and y(t), and the path they trace.
curriculo.topico.estatica-e-torque.descr: Balance of forces and moments, centre of mass and stability.
curriculo.topico.estatistica-e-incerteza: Mean, standard deviation, line fitting and error propagation in a measurement.
curriculo.topico.expressoes-algebricas.d: Variables, like terms and evaluating expressions.
curriculo.topico.fatoracao.descricao: Common factor, grouping and perfect square trinomial.
Pressure, buoyancy, Bernoulli’s equation and where lift comes from.
curriculo.topico.fracoes.descricao: Parts of a whole, equivalence, simplifying and the four operations, in both forms: fraction and mixed number. Plus converting decimals — nine types in all, three correct answers for each before the stage opens.
curriculo.topico.funcao-afim.descricao: Slope and intercept, growth and the zero of the function.
curriculo.topico.funcao-exponencial.desc: Multiplicative growth, the number e and half-life.
curriculo.topico.funcao-logaritmica.desc: The logarithm as the inverse of the exponential, and its properties.
curriculo.topico.funcao-modular.descrica: Absolute value as distance and the effect of the corner on the graph.
curriculo.topico.funcao-quadratica.descr: Parabola, vertex, concavity and maximum and minimum problems.
curriculo.topico.funcoes-de-varias-varia: Domain as a region, graph as a surface and level curves.
curriculo.topico.funcoes-por-partes.desc: A different rule on each interval, and what happens at the joins.
curriculo.topico.funcoes-racionais.descr: A quotient of polynomials: domain, asymptotes and what happens near where the denominator vanishes.
curriculo.topico.funcoes-trigonometricas: Amplitude, period and phase: the shape of the wave.
The vector of steepest ascent, and the rate in any direction.
curriculo.topico.gravitacao-e-orbitas.de: The law of gravitation, Kepler’s laws, orbital and escape velocity.
curriculo.topico.identidades-trigonometr: The fundamental identity, double angle and angle sum.
curriculo.topico.impulso-e-momento.descr: Conservation of momentum and collisions — the principle that moves a rocket.
curriculo.topico.inequacoes.descricao: Inequalities, flipping the sign and the solution set on the line.
curriculo.topico.integrais-de-linha.desc: Accumulating along a path, and when the path stops mattering.
curriculo.topico.integrais-improprias.de: Integrals with an infinite limit or an unbounded integrand, and when they converge.
curriculo.topico.integrais-multiplas.des: Summing over a region: iterated integration, volume and average value.
curriculo.topico.integral-definida.descr: Signed area and the properties of the integral.
curriculo.topico.integral-indefinida.des: Antiderivatives and why the constant of integration shows up.
curriculo.topico.juros-compostos.descric: Exponential growth applied to money over time.
curriculo.topico.lei-senos-cossenos.desc: Solving triangles that have no right angle.
curriculo.topico.leis-de-newton.descrica: Inertia, F = ma and action and reaction, with free-body diagrams.
curriculo.topico.limites-laterais.descri: Arriving from the left and from the right, and when the limit does not exist.
curriculo.topico.limites.descricao: Formal definition, properties and indeterminate forms.
Matrix operations, the determinant as area and Cramer’s rule.
curriculo.topico.metodos-numericos.descr: Euler, Runge-Kutta and the order with which the error responds to the step.
curriculo.topico.mmc-mdc.descricao: Prime factorization, Euclid’s algorithm and where each one is used.
curriculo.topico.momento-angular.descric: Why the skater speeds up when she pulls her arms in — and what that does on a satellite.
curriculo.topico.movimento-circular.desc: Angular velocity, centripetal acceleration and the force that holds the curve.
curriculo.topico.movimento-harmonico.des: The oscillation of a spring described by sine and cosine.
curriculo.topico.nocao-intuitiva-de-limi: Getting close to a value without necessarily reaching it.
curriculo.topico.notacao-matematica.desc: Reading what the symbols say and writing in symbols what you mean.
curriculo.topico.numeros-complexos.descr: The Argand plane, polar form and multiplication as rotation.
curriculo.topico.numeros-decimais.descri: Decimals as fractions with powers of ten in the denominator, and repeating decimals.
Properties of addition and multiplication, and the order of operations.
curriculo.topico.polinomios.descricao: Degree, division, the remainder theorem and the hunt for roots.
curriculo.topico.ponto-e-reta.descricao: Distance between points, the equation of a line, parallel and perpendicular.
Properties of powers, negative exponents and roots as powers.
curriculo.topico.probabilidade.descricao: Sample space, independent events and conditional probability.
curriculo.topico.produto-escalar-vetoria: Projection, angle between vectors, work and torque as products.
curriculo.topico.produtos-notaveis.descr: Square of a sum and difference of squares, with a geometric proof.
curriculo.topico.progressoes.descricao: General term, sum of terms and where each pattern shows up.
curriculo.topico.propulsao-de-foguetes.d: Thrust, specific impulse and the Tsiolkovsky equation.
curriculo.topico.razao-proporcao.descric: Comparing quantities, cross-multiplication and inverse proportionality.
curriculo.topico.regra-da-cadeia.descric: Differentiating composite functions and why the differentials appear to cancel.
curriculo.topico.regras-de-derivacao.des: Power, product and quotient, proved from the definition.
The line that best passes through the points, and how much it explains.
Similarity ratio, the intercept theorem and the proof of Pythagoras.
curriculo.topico.seno-cosseno-tangente.d: How the three ratios relate and why the tangent has asymptotes.
curriculo.topico.series-de-taylor.descri: Approximating a function with polynomials, and the error that remains.
curriculo.topico.sistemas-lineares.descr: Substitution and elimination, with the solution seen as where lines meet.
curriculo.topico.solidos-e-volumes.descr: Prisms, cylinders, cones and spheres: volume, surface area and cubic scaling.
curriculo.topico.soma-de-riemann.descric: Approximating area with rectangles and refining the partition to the limit.
curriculo.topico.taxa-de-variacao.descri: Velocity and acceleration as derivatives of position.
Substitution, integration by parts and partial fractions.
curriculo.topico.teorema-fundamental.des: The bridge showing that differentiating and integrating are inverse operations.
curriculo.topico.termodinamica-e-gases.d: Ideal gases, the first law and the work an expansion performs.
curriculo.topico.trabalho-e-energia.desc: Work as a dot product, kinetic and potential energy, and conservation.
curriculo.topico.trajetoria-balistica.de: Oblique launch: range, maximum height and time of flight.
Conduction, convection and radiation, and the re-entry of a spacecraft.
curriculo.topico.transformacoes-de-grafi: Shifting, stretching and reflecting — reading the graph of f(x) + k, f(x + k) and a·f(x) without redoing the table.
curriculo.topico.triangulo-retangulo.des: Sine, cosine and tangent as ratios of sides, and Pythagoras.
curriculo.topico.vetores-no-espaco.descr: The x, y and z components, unit vectors and both products in three dimensions.
curriculo.topico.vetores-no-plano.descri: Magnitude, direction and sense, the parallelogram rule and decomposition.
Epsilon and delta, and how functions behave at infinity.
